description: This source file defines a mic level monitoring component using AVFoundation for capturing audio input, processing the decibel level, and providing a visual representation via SwiftUI. It includes an actor for managing audio input, with start and stop controls, and a view for displaying the mic level as a bar segmented view.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor class that manages audio input from microphone, measures the audio level in real-time, and sends updates through a callback closure.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that visualizes the microphone level as segmented colored bars.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the microphone level monitoring, configuring the AVAudioEngine and installing a tap for audio data.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the microphone monitoring and releases the audio engine resources.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates the smoothed level and calls the update callback on the main thread.

methods.name: normalizedLevel
methods.description: Calculates the normalized audio level in the range [0, 1] from an audio buffer.
